summary: Frontend-only verification of Staff My-Leads campaign filter + badge and Admin All-leads campaign filter. Created a KM_BLR test campaign as super admin, bulk-uploaded a 2-row CSV (employee=Fathima Telecaller, campaign_id=<test>), then verified UI as both roles and cleaned up. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadsPipeline.jsx line 187 useEffect deps include allLeadsMode but not campaignId — minor: campaign list won't refetch if campaignId prop changes at runtime. Non-blocking (campaignId doesn't change for a mounted pipeline in current usage).
Staff campaign badge is only rendered when isStaff && l.campaign_id (line 463). Admin non-allLeadsMode view (e.g. inside a specific campaign pipeline) intentionally hides the badge — correct.
The `[data-testid^="lead-card-"]` prefix also matches child `lead-card-open-<id>` — not a bug but worth noting for test authors so counts appear doubled.
seed_data_creation: Created a temporary campaign TEST_STAFF_CAMPAIGN_<ts> in KM_BLR + 2 leads (TEST_Alice, TEST_Bob) assigned to Fathima Telecaller. Deleted via DELETE /api/campaigns/{id}?delete_leads=true after tests (returned 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login button testid is `auth-submit-btn` (not `auth-submit`). Staff route is /leads; admin /leads has crm-tab-all for the All-leads view. `[data-testid^="lead-card-"]` also matches the inner `lead-card-open-<id>` button, so raw counts double — use `[data-testid^="lead-card-"]:not([data-testid^="lead-card-open-"])` or check `[data-testid^="lead-campaign-badge-"]` for lead count in filtered results.
